events.title: Hormuz reopening may cause tanker rates to rise or fall, says CMB.Tech CEO
events.body: Investing.com - The head of Belgian tanker firm CMB.Tech said on Tuesday that uncertainty remains over whether reopening the Strait of Hormuz would cause freight rates to rise or fall, despite the current boom in the tanker market.
